# chain id

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:chainId`](gmeow-chainId.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/chainId>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The chain identifier of a blockchain network (e.g. CAIP-2 [`chainId`](gmeow-chainId.md), eip155:1).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:chainId`](gmeow-chainId.md) from [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the CAIP-2 chain identifier of a [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md) — the string that distinguishes one chain from another when resolving on-chain identifiers.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a contract or account address on the chain ([`gmeow:contractAddress`](gmeow-contractAddress.md), [`gmeow:signatureRecoveryAddress`](gmeow-signatureRecoveryAddress.md)) and for a transaction hash ([`gmeow:transactionHash`](gmeow-transactionHash.md)); the chain id names the network, not a record on it. Functional — one id per network.

### How to use

- Set one CAIP-2 chain-id literal on the [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](../classes/gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md); other ledger records reference the network so their hashes and addresses are interpreted against the right chain.

### Examples

- ex:ethMainnet [`gmeow:chainId`](gmeow-chainId.md) "eip155:1".
